# Step - visualize

`visualize` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and renders its results in the given V format (default: the session's).

## Forms

```text
visualize()
visualize(arg1: VisualizeFormat)
visualize(arg1: VisualizeFormat, arg2: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").visualize(V.Json)
```

## See also

- [Displaying Results](../../users_guide/displaying_results.md)
